title: Incredible Morning Exercises
synopsis: What are some of the most popular types of morning exercise in China?

fullText.simplified:
厉害的晨练

    随着中国经济的快速发展，人们的生活水平越来越高了。人们不再只满足生活上吃饱穿暖了，开始追求活得高兴、活得健康了。所以，锻炼成了中国人生活中不可缺少的一部分。
    说到锻炼，就不得不说说中国老人的晨练，那绝对是只有你想不到的，没有你看不到的。在中国，早上的公园是最热闹的，因为你可以看到很多忙着锻炼的人们，这其中老人们的晨练是最有看头的，因为他们锻炼的种类和方法多种多样。
    慢慢地散步不新鲜，倒着走路你见过吗？公园里很多老人会选择倒着走路的锻炼方式，据说这种方式不仅对肺好，还对心脏特别好，同时还可以锻炼平衡力。
    和太极有关的活动，比如，太极拳、太极剑等也是老人喜欢的晨练活动。公园里，广场上那些跟着音乐打太极的老人，一招一式都非常专业，吸引了很多感兴趣的人加入其中。
    要说最有意思、最惊险的晨练，就是那些六七十岁的大爷们玩的单杠了。他们有的用双手抓住单杠，做引体向上，一口气做一二十个也没问题，要知道就连专业的运动员一下子做二十个也是有难度的哦；有的像奥运会上的体操运动员一样，在单杠上绕圈，那样的动作恐怕连年轻小伙子也不敢轻易尝试；还有的不知道用了什么方法，用脚勾住单杠，然后360度的绕圈。天哪！完全没有保护措施。
    当然，像上面提到的危险的晨练方式不值得提倡和推广，但从另一个侧面也说明了中国人的幸福指数提高了，大部分中国老年人开始享受幸福的晚年时光了。各种各样的晨练就是老年人生活幸福的标志。
fullText.traditional:
厲害的晨練

    隨著中國經濟的快速發展，人們的生活水平越來越高了。人們不再只滿足生活上吃飽穿暖了，開始追求活得高興、活得健康了。所以，鍛鍊成了中國人生活中不可缺少的一部分。
    說到鍛鍊，就不得不說說中國老人的晨練，那絕對是只有你想不到的，沒有你看不到的。在中國，早上的公園是最熱鬧的，因為你可以看到很多忙著鍛鍊的人們，這其中老人們的晨練是最有看頭的，因為他們鍛鍊的種類和方法多種多樣。
    慢慢地散步不新鮮，倒著走路你見過嗎？公園裡很多老人會選擇倒著走路的鍛鍊方式，據說這種方式不僅對肺好，還對心臟特別好，同時還可以鍛鍊平衡力。
    和太極有關的活動，比如，太極拳、太極劍等也是老人喜歡的晨練活動。公園裡，廣場上那些跟著音樂打太極的老人，一招一式都非常專業，吸引了很多感興趣的人加入其中。
    要說最有意思、最驚險的晨練，就是那些六七十歲的大爺們玩的單槓了。他們有的用雙手抓住單槓，做引體向上，一口氣做一二十個也沒問題，要知道就連專業的運動員一下子做二十個也是有難度的哦；有的像奧運會上的體操運動員一樣，在單槓上繞圈，那樣的動作恐怕連年輕小伙子也不敢輕易嘗試；還有的不知道用了什麼方法，用腳勾住單槓，然後360度的繞圈。天哪！完全沒有保護措施。
    當然，像上面提到的危險的晨練方式不值得提倡和推廣，但從另一個側面也說明了中國人的幸福指數提高了，大部分中國老年人開始享受幸福的晚年時光了。各種各樣的晨練就是老年人生活幸福的標誌。

sentences.simplified: 所以，锻炼成了中国人生活中不可缺少的一部分。

sentences.english: People are no longer just satisfying their need to have adequate food and clothing; they’ve started to pursue happiness and health.
As a result, physical exercise has become an inextricable part of Chinese people’s lives.

sentences.english: When it comes to exercise, we can’t ignore the morning exercises of old people in China.

sentences.traditional: 這其中老人們的晨練是最有看頭的，因為他們鍛鍊的種類和方法多種多樣。

sentences.english: In China, parks in the morning are bustling because you can see many people busy exercising.
Of these exercises, the morning exercises of old people are most worth seeing because their exercises have many types and methods.

sentences.simplified: 同时还可以锻炼平衡力。
sentences.traditional: 同時還可以鍛鍊平衡力。
sentences.pinyin: tóng shí hái kě yǐ duàn liàn píng héng lì
sentences.english: It is said that as well as being good for the lungs, it is also particularly good for the heart.
At the same time, it can also train your balance.

.. attracting many interested people to join in.

sentences.traditional: 他們有的用雙手抓住單槓，做引體向上，
sentences.pinyin: tā men yǒu de yòng shuāng shǒu zhuā zhù dān gàng zuò yǐn tǐ xiàng shàng
sentences.english: As for the most interesting and thrilling morning exercise, it has to be the horizontal bar exercises of old men in their 60s and 70s.

sentences.traditional: 一口氣做一二十個也沒問題，

sentences.traditional: 要知道就連專業的運動員一下子做二十個也是有難度的哦；

sentences.english: It’s no problem for them to do 10 or 20 pull-ups at a time.

sentences.traditional: 有的像奧運會上的體操運動員一樣，在單槓上繞圈，

sentences.traditional: 那樣的動作恐怕連年輕小伙子也不敢輕易嘗試；

sentences.english: Even young men will probably not dare to rashly try this action.

sentences.pinyin: tiān na wán quán méi yǒu bǎo hù cuò shī
sentences.english: Others still, by some unknown means, grip their feet on the bar and rotate 360 degrees.
Good gracious! This is all without any protective measures.

sentences.english: Of course, these dangerous morning exercises should not be advocated and promoted.

sentences.traditional: 大部分中國老年人開始享受幸福的晚年時光了。

sentences.english: But on the other hand, this also demonstrates that Chinese people’s happiness index has increased, ..

sentences.simplified: 各种各样的晨练就是老年人生活幸福的标志。
sentences.traditional: 各種各樣的晨練就是老年人生活幸福的標誌。
sentences.pinyin: gè zhǒng gè yàng de chén liàn jiù shì lǎo nián rén shēng huó xìng fú de biāo zhì
sentences.english: .. and most old people in China have started to enjoy their later years of life.

sentence_translations: Incredible Morning Exercises
With the rapid development of China’s economy, people’s living standards have grown higher and higher.
People are no longer just satisfying their need to have adequate food and clothing; they’ve started to pursue happiness and health.
As a result, physical exercise has become an inextricable part of Chinese people’s lives.
When it comes to exercise, we can’t ignore the morning exercises of old people in China.
They are something that you might not think of but will definitely see.
In China, parks in the morning are bustling because you can see many people busy exercising.
Of these exercises, the morning exercises of old people are most worth seeing because their exercises have many types and methods.
Walking slowly is not new. But have you ever seen backward walking?
Many old people in the parks choose backward walking as a form of exercise.
It is said that as well as being good for the lungs, it is also particularly good for the heart.
At the same time, it can also train your balance.
Tai chi related activities, such as taijiquan and taijijian are also morning exercises popular among old people.
In the park, old people practicing tai chi to music are very professional in their postures and movement, ..
.. attracting many interested people to join in.
As for the most interesting and thrilling morning exercise, it has to be the horizontal bar exercises of old men in their 60s and 70s.
They grasp the horizontal bar with both hands and do pull-ups.
It’s no problem for them to do 10 or 20 pull-ups at a time.
You should know that even professional athletes find it hard to do 20 pull-ups in one go.
Some are like those gymnasts in the Olympic Games, rotating around the bar.
Even young men will probably not dare to rashly try this action.
Others still, by some unknown means, grip their feet on the bar and rotate 360 degrees.
Good gracious! This is all without any protective measures.
Of course, these dangerous morning exercises should not be advocated and promoted.
But on the other hand, this also demonstrates that Chinese people’s happiness index has increased, ..
.. and most old people in China have started to enjoy their later years of life.
These various types of morning exercises are signs of old people’s happiness.
